newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: STATE FOREIGN DEBT RISES IN H1.
newsitem.headline: STATE FOREIGN DEBT RISES IN H1.

text.p: Lithuania's foreign debt in hard currency stood at $1.267 billion as of July 1 compared to $1.175 billion at the start of the year, the finance ministry on Wednesday.
The debt in the name of the state at the start of July was $934.83 million compared to $884.7 million at the beginning of the year.
Loans taken with government guarantees rose to $332.38 million from $290.22 million in the first six months of the year.
The total foreign debt amounted to 13.8 percent of the country's gross domestic product on July 1, a fall from 15.1 percent at the start of the year.
